source_basis.explicit_scope: Anonymised trip logs across cab, nodal and shuttle modes, including vendor performance, GPS traces, delay records, cost data, and employee feedback.
source_basis.limitation: The problem statement does not define filenames, columns, types, row grain, units, or relationships. Those details are synthetic assumptions and must be remapped when the organizer dataset arrives.

controlled_scenarios.golden_anomaly: Enterprise A recent night-shift service on two primary vendors and selected routes has lower OTA, poorer GPS coverage, higher cost, and worse feedback than its prior baseline.
